_comment: ComfyUI API-format workflow for LLM64 scene illustrations, SDXL.
Written for NovaFurryXL (Illustrious-based), which draws anthro
characters as anthro instead of sliding into humans - the reason
this exists alongside the Flux workflow. Any other SDXL / Pony /
Illustrious checkpoint runs here too: change [images.comfyui] model.
Every value the proxy has a reason to change is a {TOKEN} filled
from [images.comfyui] in config.toml (see imagegen.COMFY_DEFAULTS).
A node input that is EXACTLY one token keeps that token's type, so
"width": "{WIDTH}" arrives as the integer ComfyUI validates for.
Those global defaults are Flux's (8 steps, cfg 1, res_multistep, a
Flux checkpoint filename) and are wrong for SDXL, so this file
carries its own in _defaults below: picking this workflow alone is
enough to get a working run. [images.comfyui] and style presets
still override any of them.
The 'nova-furry' style preset selects this workflow AND brings the
tag-style prefix that goes with the model - it is the fuller
answer, and the one to use unless you are writing your own look.
No {VAE}: an SDXL checkpoint carries its own, and the {VAE} default
names a Flux one. No {CLIP} either, for the same reason.
1280x800 is 1.6:1 exactly - the C64 frame - so imaging.py's
letterbox throws nothing away, at SDXL's ~1 megapixel budget. It is
tempting to raise it, since the short edge is under SDXL's native
1024. Measured, on two seeds: at 1344x896 and above this checkpoint
starts duplicating characters (a third figure in a `duo` shot) and
shrinking the subject toward the horizon. 1216x832 is an exact
training bucket and just as clean, but 1.46:1 loses a tenth of the
width to the letterbox. If you do raise it, judge it in the
launcher's Illustrations tab before believing it.
The negative below is the model family's own quality floor, and it
is kept SEPARATE from {NEGATIVE} so the config's negative prompt
adds to it rather than replacing it.
This key is ignored by ComfyUI - it is not a node.

inputs.text: {NEGATIVE}, worst quality, low quality, bad quality, lowres, jpeg artifacts, bad anatomy, bad proportions, bad hands, extra digits, fewer digits, deformed, mutated, sketch, unfinished, simple background, monochrome, speech bubble
